objectives: Decode taught gn-words from left to right.
Recognise that initial g is silent and the first spoken sound is /n/.
Distinguish gnat, gnaw, and gnome by the rest of the word.
Reread and self-correct when a sound is missed.
concepts: In taught initial gn words, g is silent.
The spelling keeps g before n.
The rest of the word must also be decoded.
